question.text: Which of the following is NOT an input to the Black-Scholes option pricing model?

answer.text: The current spot price of the underlying

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists five inputs/determinants of the Black-Scholes option price: spot (or stock) price, strike price, time to expiration, risk-free interest rate, and volatility. Historical trading volume is not among them. The Trap: The other three choices are all legitimate Black-Scholes inputs. Trading volume relates to liquidity, not the theoretical option price formula. Note: The workbook also notes that for exchange-traded interest rate options in India, theoretical pricing uses the Black 1976 model (which takes the futures price as an input) rather than the Black-Scholes spot price.
